name: ManaVoid
subtitle: Commander game tracker for Magic: The Gathering
description: Local-first, offline Commander life tracker. Track life totals, commander damage, poison counters, and game history — no account, no internet required.

news.title: ManaVoid is moving to Google Play and the App Store
news.caption: This AltStore source is retired. Installed copies keep working until their signature expires; new versions will come through the official stores. Updates: manavoid.app
